svg.text: A | Nine approved openings, nine complete real-inference paths
9 raw move sequences | 7 D4 trajectory classes | all 9 games draw after 9 marks | host policy emulation
Read left to right. Every board is an actual saved state; amber is the newest mark. Squares use 123 / 456 / 789.
D4 class = one fixed rotation/reflection applied to the entire time-ordered sequence, not a new transform at each step.
B | Only the opening branches. Every later turn restores the whole approved set and applies raw tie order afresh.
No screenshot mockups; these are annotated offline diagrams, not captured C64 output. Full vectors: game-stages015.npz.
